criteria.requirement: Run export with the input list and --output file in a real process. Preserve only sku/name/quantity in order, save actual Chinese characters in UTF-8, support an empty array, and independently read the output to verify it.

Enforce an array of objects, non-empty strings, non-negative integer quantities that exclude bool, and unique sku values. Invalid JSON or any invalid record must produce a nonzero exit and an explanation, leaving no partial output.

Refuse to overwrite existing output; reject identical input and output paths; leave the input unchanged; clearly fail when the input is missing. Printing JSON alone must not stand in for writing the file.
Preserve the product subcommand’s behavior: quantity 3, a default of 1, and rejection of negative quantities. Root and export help must not create output files.

Modify only app/shop.py, app/tests/, and app/README.md; preserve catalog.json, the Typer library, and the environment. Provide user tests with real business assertions and brief usage documentation. Self-reported success does not replace independent verification.

baseline_expectation: APP-R0 has no export command, so this engineering target is expected to fail on the original version. A controller-side reference candidate may demonstrate that the target is achievable, but the reference implementation must not be supplied to the model.
